proposed_widenings.name: passive_triggered_spell_save_rider
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has an automatic while-worn rider that fires after you succeed on a saving throw against a qualifying spell. That is neither a passive grants list nor an activated/reaction ability in the current magic-item families.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.sourceFilter.spell_only
proposed_widenings.justification: The current modify_roll_advantage atom can target saving throws generally, but it cannot narrow the advantage to saving throws caused by spells only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells.

proposed_widenings.name: reaction_trigger.successful_save_against_triggering_spell
proposed_widenings.justification: The reflection reaction only opens after a successful save against the triggering spell and must preserve extra predicates: spell level 7 or lower, targeted only you, and no area of effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If that spell targeted only you and didn't create an area of effect, you can take a Reaction to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster.

notes: No content file was authored. The existing effect atoms can express spell negation/reflection, but the item needs a missing automatic triggered-rider family plus narrower trigger/filter variants.
